free_tier.stated: EUR 3 per month for 1 vCPU, 1 GB ECC REG, 15 GB NVMe, 10 Gbps port with 5 TB included, one IPv4, on Intel Xeon Gold 6240R with VMware, valid in any of the proposed locations. The high-frequency line in Russia (Moscow) is EUR 4 per month for 1 vCPU, 1 GB, 20 GB NVMe at 1 Gbps with 5 TB. The page title states a starting price of EUR 2 per month while the cheapest row in either table is EUR 3, so the title and the table disagree. Three, six and twelve month terms carry 5, 10 and 15 percent off.

egress.terms: 5 TB a month on every row, 10 Gbps on the Xeon Gold line and 1 Gbps on the high-frequency line; no overage price stated
